caption: The drawing depicts a textile object, likely a shawl or scarf, with a rectangular shape. The top portion is a light beige color with white floral patterns and leaf motifs. On the right side, the fabric displays vertical white lines of varying thickness, and a subtle decorative diamond-like pattern is present alongside the stripes. Below this beige section, there is a wide, horizontal red band that has intricate white floral designs, geometric shapes, small squares, and decorative borders toward its lower edge. The right side of the red band contains vertical red and white stripes of various thicknesses. The lower edge of the textile is finished with long, dense, white fringe that spreads outwards, covering the bottom edge of the drawing. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light background with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Linen - Red Border with Sunflower
